How I work

From question to answer in three steps

A simple process, so you always know where your project stands.

1

Understand the question

We define the decision you need to make and what data you already have.

2

Clean & analyze

I clean and organize the data, then analyze it with the right tools: SQL, Python, Power BI or Excel.

3

Deliver clarity

You receive a dashboard, presentation or report you can read and act on right away.

Who I am

About me

I’m a freelance data analyst and researcher. I work on anything that starts with a question and ends with a clear answer: preparing research, cleaning and organizing messy data, analyzing it, building dashboards in Power BI, and presenting the findings in clean PowerPoint decks.

I studied Economics with a Statistics minor at Cairo University, and I trained in Power BI, SQL, Python and Excel. I care about delivering work the client can read and use right away.
